cllms.config.title: CLLMs for Copilot Chat
cllms.config.baseUrl.description: Qwen (DashScope 国内) API base URL (OpenAI-compatible). Defaults to the Beijing endpoint https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1. For the international Singapore endpoint, use the Qwen (DashScope International) provider instead.
cllms.config.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of output tokens per request. Set to 0 to use the API default (no limit). Useful for controlling costs.
cllms.config.maxRetries.description: Number of automatic retries for transient request failures (HTTP 429, 5xx, or network blips) before any output is streamed. Honors the server's `Retry-After` header and uses exponential backoff with jitter. Retries stop once output has started so they never duplicate a response. Set to 0 to disable.
cllms.config.experimental.stabilizeToolL:
**Experimental**: improve context-cache hit rate by pre-activating available tools.
- When the enabled tools list changes across turns, this may improve context-cache hit rate.
- Requests will include more function definitions, so input tokens may increase. Cache-hit input tokens are billed at a lower price, but still count toward usage.
- This may add internal preflight tool calls to the current Copilot chat history. If you switch to another model in the same conversation, that model provider may reject or mishandle the replayed history. Start a new chat if model switching behaves unexpectedly.

Use [Configure Tools](command:workbench.action.chat.configureTools) to **view and manage** your tool list:

- 64 or fewer enabled tools: usually no need to enable this unless the tool list still changes across turns.
- More than 128 enabled tools: not recommended. Providers support at most 128 functions in one `tools` request. Consider disabling tools you rarely use.
cllms.config.experimental.sortToolsForCa:
**Experimental**: sort the request `tools` array alphabetically by name.

VS Code/Copilot may reorder the enabled tools between turns even when the set is unchanged; some providers key their context cache on the exact `tools` prefix, so reordering alone can cause cache misses. Sorting makes the order stable across turns. Off by default; works alongside `cllms.experimental.stabilizeToolList`.
cllms.config.experimental.replayReasonin:
**Experimental**: how much marker-replayed `reasoning_content` to re-send on later turns for thinking models.

- **all** (default): replay reasoning for every assistant turn — keeps tool-call histories complete (required by Qwen) and the request prefix byte-stable.
- **latest-tool-loop**: only replay reasoning for the in-flight tool-call loop (turns at or after your most recent message) and drop it from older turns to save input tokens on long sessions.
Replay reasoning_content for every assistant turn (most compatible).
Only replay reasoning_content for the current tool-call loop; drop older turns to save tokens.
cllms.config.visionProxy.timeoutMs.descr: Per-request timeout (in milliseconds) for the API-endpoint vision proxy that describes images for text-only models. Clamped to 1000–120000. Lower it so a slow vision endpoint fails fast instead of stalling the chat.
cllms.config.utility.maxOutputTokens.des: Cap output tokens for one-shot utility/helper requests only (chat titles, commit messages, branch names, inline progress, rename suggestions, prompt categorization, settings resolution, todo tracking). Set to 0 to disable. Combined with `cllms.maxTokens` by taking the smaller value. Does not affect agent/chat turns.
cllms.config.utility.modelIdByProvider.d: Route utility/helper requests to a cheaper API model on the same provider, keyed by provider id (`qwen`, `qwen-intl`, `deepseek`, `zai`, `minimax`, `minimax-intl`, `xiaomi`, `moonshot`, `moonshot-intl`, `hunyuan`). Example: `{ "qwen": "qwen-flash" }`. Empty by default (no downgrade). Session cost estimates use the override model when it matches a known model with pricing; unknown override IDs are counted as unbilled usage. Prefer VS Code's native `chat.utilityModel` (see `CLLMs: Configure Utility Model`) when possible.
cllms.config.debugMode.description:
Controls what diagnostic information CLLMs writes. Token usage is always reported to Copilot regardless of this setting.

- **Minimal** — Token usage only. No diagnostic logs or request dumps.
- **Metadata** — Privacy-safe diagnostic metadata (request hashes, prefix overlap, tool schema changes). Does not contain prompt text — safe to share in public issue reports. View with [`CLLMs: Show Logs`](command:cllms.showLogs).
- **Verbose** — Complete request payloads written to disk for local debugging. **Warning: contains sensitive prompt content.** View with [`CLLMs: Open Request Dumps Folder`](command:cllms.openRequestDumpsFolder).
